R.data_reference: definitional; gas constant, as the library's SN modules

T.data_reference: lynch2015bioenergetic; operating point 20 C, the temperature Lynch & Marinov normalise maintenance costs to

C_glc_e.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; glucose in the medium between food: a lean background, 0.1 mM (open-ocean dissolved glucose is nM-uM; placeholder). The cell is calibrated to just maintain itself here, so growth needs food

C_lac_e.data_reference: definitional; no lactate in the medium

A_mem.data_reference: geometry: in-plane membrane of the 2 um cell

m_expr.data_reference: definitional; n_0 copies, as many as the calibrated cell has Glf

jmax_glc.data_reference: derived: n_0 x turnover_PTS / N_A / A_mem: m = 1 has as many copies as the calibrated cell's Glf (turnover_PTS: unreferenced_placeholder, placeholder; turnover_Glf: unreferenced_placeholder, placeholder)

K_glc_t.data_reference: deutscher2006how; glucose PTS (PtsG/EIICB-Glc) Km ~3-10 uM; 5 uM, inside the range (as summarised in AdaptOrDeity research notes docs/research/food-uptake-and-extracellular-space.md (2026-10-12))

K_m_ATP.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; ATP (for the PTS, PEP in ATP equivalents) for half-rate of the ATP-coupled glucose carriers; order 0.1 mM

K_ADP_PEP.data_reference: chassagnole2002dynamic; lumped glycolysis affinity for ADP: the ADP constants of its two ATP-making steps in the E. coli kinetic model, PGK 0.185 and pyruvate kinase 0.26 mM (BIOMD0000000051)

K_Pi_PEP.data_reference: eyschen1999engineered; lumped glycolysis affinity for Pi: E. coli glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase Km(Pi) 0.53 mM

ATP.data_reference: bennett2009absolute; glucose-fed, exponentially growing E. coli: ATP 9.6 mM

ADP.data_reference: bennett2009absolute; glucose-fed, exponentially growing E. coli: ADP 0.56 mM (Table 1)

Pi.data_reference: amin1995dual; cytoplasmic Pi of E. coli near 10 mM in typical growth (BioNumbers BNID 105540, from Amin & Peterkofsky 1995 and Rao & Torriani 1994); 20-30 mM in carbon-starved cells

C_G6P.data_reference: chassagnole2002dynamic; glucose 6-phosphate in the resting cell, a chosen operating point in the measured range: E. coli in glucose-limited chemostat culture (D = 0.1 /h) 3.48 mM G6P (Chassagnole et al. 2002, Table V; the initial value of their model, BioModels BIOMD0000000051), exponentially growing on glucose 8.8 mM hexose phosphates (G6P + F6P + G1P; Bennett et al. 2009, Table 1, which does not resolve G6P). 1 mM, below the growing cells' values, as the level-1 cell runs at its maintenance flux (confidence: medium; the range 0.5-4 mM is well supported, the exact resting value is a choice)

dG0_hk.data_reference: beber2022equilibrator; glucose + ATP -> glucose 6-phosphate + ADP: -17.9 +- 0.8 kJ/mol, eQuilibrator 3.0 at pH 7.0, pMg 3, I 0.25 M, 25 C (under 0.5 kJ/mol from its value at 20 C); the four standard Gibbs energies are one set

c_std.data_reference: definitional; standard concentration 1 M for thermodynamic factors
